### Marriage at the Resurrection
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/marriage-resurrection
Passage: Matthew 22:29-30
Points:
- Opposing religious factions united in hostility to challenge Jesus with a legal riddle.
- The Sadducees mistakenly assumed that the resurrection life would merely duplicate earthly life.
- Jesus rebuked their skepticism as ignorance of both Scripture and God's power.
- Marriage was ordained for this present world and will not exist in the resurrection.
- Earthly marriage will give way to a state where divine love is fully perfected.

### The God of the Living
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/god-living
Passage: Matthew 22:31-32
Points:
- Jesus demonstrated the resurrection using Exodus 3:6 from the Pentateuch.
- God identified Himself in the present tense as the God of Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob.
- The patriarchs still live to worship God because death cannot sever His covenant bond.
- Believers' spirits remain in God's presence now, awaiting future bodily resurrection.
- The Lord is not the God of the dead, assuring His people of everlasting life.

### The Sadducees Ask About Marriage
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/sadducees-ask-about-marriage
Passage: Mark 12:24
Points:
- The Sadducees rejected the resurrection because they found no explicit mention in the Torah.
- They crafted an extreme scenario using levirate marriage to make the resurrection look absurd.
- Jesus traced their fundamental theological error to ignorance of God's Word and power.
- Biblical truth is often taught implicitly and must be deduced by sound understanding.
- Neglecting to know and study the Scriptures is the root source of spiritual error.
